# Draft:Vice Presidential Palace (Jakarta)

}}
The Vice Presidential Palace () on Merdeka Selatan Street in Jakarta is still partially occupied by the offices of the Vice President of Indonesia and Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka. As the new Vice Presidential Palace has been completed in January 2026, the family and offices of the Vice President are now under relocation process from Jakarta to Nusantara.
